# Coriolis, LLC

Coriolis builds websites gun stores own, puts Betsy on those sites, and sells anonymized category search to brands. Greenville, SC.

## Products and prices
- FFL Accelerator — $569 a month. WooCommerce on the dealer domain. Setup $500 or $2,500. No year lock. They leave with the site.
- Gun Search Engine — free on a dealer site. Included with FFL Accelerator.
- Demand Intelligence — brands. Full-market anonymized search. Seats $49 per user per month. One Client Admin free.
- Grok Bot setup — $995. One session. Their Cursor seat. We never rent them ours.
- Gun Store Game — consumer game. Dealer claim is a separate door.

- /best-ffl-ecommerce-website, /firearms-dropshipping, /ffl-cockpit — store pages
- /email-marketing-for-ffl-ecommerce — Accelerator email (no LTV claim)
- /woocommerce-vs-shopify-for-gun-stores — owned Woo vs hosted Shopify
- /aim-pos, /microbiz-pos, /trident-1-pos, /corestore-pos, /rapid-gun-systems-pos — keep-your-register
- /privacy, /msa, /confirmed, /unsubscribe — legal and list

Old /ai-factory links go to /ai-studio. /plans goes to /ecommerce. /demand-intelligence goes to GunSearchEngine Demand Intelligence.

We do not file a 4473, run NICS, write a bound book, or run the register. We are not affiliated with Gearfire or RetailBI.
